Keeping up with Elon Musk's children
Elon Musk has 13 children he has confirmed, and a possible 14th child whose paternity is now being determined by a New York court.
Musk, the world's richest man, has six children with his ex-wife, Justine Wilson.
Musk shares three children with musician Grimes.
The tech billionaire also has four children with tech executive Shivon Zilis.
Elon Musk, the billionaire chief executive and technology entrepreneur, has built not just rockets and electric cars but an unusually large and complex family. Over more than two decades, he has fathered at least 14 children with multiple partners.
The scope of his family life aligns with views he has repeatedly expressed in public, including his embrace of the “pronatalist” movement, which argues that declining birthrates threaten long-term social and economic stability and encourages people — particularly those with means — to have more kids.
In a July 2021 post on X, Musk warned that “population collapse is potentially the greatest risk to the future of civilization.”
Elon Musk's children, by relationship:
Six children with his ex-wife, Justine Wilson, including their first child, a boy named Nevada, who died as an infant.
Three children with musician Grimes, whose legal name is Claire Elise Boucher.
Four children with tech executive Shivon Zilis.
Walter Isaacson, who wrote a biography and Time magazine cover story about Musk, spoke about the businessman's views on family during a 2023 appearance on TODAY.
“He believes that people should have many more children,” Isaacson explained, adding that Musk personally "wants to have a lot of children.”
Here’s a closer look at Elon Musk's relationships with his kids.
Nevada Alexander Musk (2002 -2002) — with Justine Wilson
Musk and his first wife welcomed their first child, a son, in 2022. The infant died at 10 weeks old from complications related to sudden infant death syndrome, according to the New York Times.
“My firstborn son died in my arms,” Musk wrote in a February 2022 email exchange reported by Business Insider India. “I felt his heartbeat.”
Later that year, Wilson refuted Musk's claim that he had been the one to hold their son in his final moments, writing on X: “A SIDS-related incident that put him on life support. He was declared brain-dead. And not that it matters to anyone except me because it is one of the most sacred and defining moments of my life, but I was the one who was holding him.”
Griffin Musk (2004) — with Justine Wilson
After the death of their son, Nevada, Musk and Wilson welcomed their first set of multiple children: a pair of twins.
Griffin Musk and Vivian Wilson were conceived via in vitro fertilization, according to an October 2024 profile by the New York Times.
In May 2024, Musk commented on a photo shared on X that he and Griffin had attended an American Express event together in Miami.
"That’s my eldest son, Griffin, who was with me at the event," he wrote.
Griffin has largely remained out of public view, and unlike some of his siblings, he has not spoken publicly or attracted sustained media attention.
Vivian Jenna Wilson (2004) — with Justine Wilson
Wilson, who was born in 2004, is a twin to her brother Griffin and has become one of Musk's most outspoken children in recent years.
In 2022, she legally changed her name and gender, saying in a court filing that both her gender identity and her desire to distance herself from her father informed the decision. “I no longer live with or wish to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form," she wrote in the petition, according to the Associated Press.
Musk later said in a 2024 interview with the conservative commentator Jordan Peterson that Wilson had been “killed by the woke mind virus,” a remark that drew widespread criticism.
Shortly afterward, Wilson told NBC News that she had not spoken to her father in four years. “I am an adult. I am 20 years old. I am not a child,” she said. “My life should never be defined by my own choices.”
In a March 2025 profile for Teen Vogue, Wilson was sharply critical of her father, calling him "a pathetic man-child."
She said she was often unaware of the full extent of her family, adding, "I will say I do not actually know how many siblings I have, if you include half-siblings." she said in the interview. She said she learned about some of his children at the same time as the public, including one through a post on Reddit.
Speaking about her gender identity and coming out to her parent as transgender, Wilson claimed Musk "was not as supportive" as her mother and described the difficulties of securing medical care while estranged from him.
"I had not talked to him in months," she said, recalling the need to obtain parental consent for testosterone blockers and hormone replacement therapy.
Kai Musk (2006) — with Justine Wilson
After the birth of the twins, Musk and Wilson went on to have triplets — all boys — in 2006. The three children are Kai, Saxon and Damian.
Their birth order has not been made public. Musk has occasionally referenced the triplets in public.
In Aug. 2024, he commented on a photograph posted on X showing him meeting India’s prime minister, writing that two of the boys were his sons, though he did not specify which ones.
Saxon Musk (2006) — with Justine Wilson
Saxon is one of Musk and Wilson’s triplets, born in 2006. Musk has referenced his son multiple times on X.
"My 14-year-old son, Saxon, said he feels like 2021 will be a good year," Musk posted in January 2021. "I agree. Let us all make it so."
In June 2022, Musk wrote on the platform, "My son, Saxon, suggested having a party for the whole world, a world party day!"
Damian Musk (2006) — with Justine Wilson
Damian is one of Musk and Wilson's triplets, born in 2006.
In 2021, Musk commented on a video shared on X of Damian playing a piano during a visit to a senior living community.
Two years after the birth of their triplets, in 2008, Musk and Wilson divorced, according to NBC News.
X Æ A-Xii Musk (2020) — with Grimes
Musk and the Canadian musician Grimes had a son in May 2020.
The child was originally named X Æ A-12, but the name was later modified to X Æ A-Xii to comply with California birth-certificate regulations. His parents refer to him as X.
Shortly after the child’s birth Musk explained the name’s pronunciation on The Joe Rogan Experience, saying it is pronounced “X Ash A Twelve.” He added that the name was largely Grimes’s idea, with his own contribution coming in the reference to the A-12 aircraft.
Musk and Grimes announced their separation in Sept. 2021, later briefly rekindled their relationship, then separated again, describing themselves at the time as “semi-separated.”
In recent years, Musk has occasionally appeared in public with his son. In 2025, he brought X with him to the Oval Office, where the then-4-year-old drew attention with photographers and onlookers as Musk spoke with reporters. During the appearance, X made faces, climbed on the furniture and wandered near the Resolute desk, moments that quickly circulated online
Strider and Azure Musk (2021) — with Shivon Zilis
In November 2021, Mr. Musk welcomed twins, Strider and Azure, with Shivon Zilis, a senior executive at Neuralink.
In his Time magazine cover story on Mr. Musk, the biographer Walter Isaacson described Ms. Zilis as Mr. Musk’s “intellectual companion on artificial intelligence” dating back to the founding of OpenAI eight years earlier. Mr. Isaacson also disclosed the twins’ names in the article and published a photograph of them.
A 2024 New York Times profile on Musk reported that he had built a $35 million “family compound” in Texas for all of his children and two of their mothers to live together. Zilis had reportedly moved into one of the homes on the compound with their children.
On Sept. 8, 2023, Zilis shared a video on X of her twins running around, with one of them yelling, “I love you.”
Exa Dark Sideræl Musk (2021) — with Grimes
Musk and Grimes welcomed a daughter, Exa Dark Sideræl, via surrogate in Dec. 2021, just weeks after the birth of Musk’s twins with Shivon Zilis.
In 2023, Grimes shared on X that she had spoken with Zilis and discussed their plans for co-parenting.
“I spoke with Shivon at length finally, which was long overdue. This wasn’t her fault, plz don’t be angry at her! We respect each other a lot and we’re excited to become friends and have the kids grow up together,” she wrote.
She added, “Women are so often pitted against each other. Speaking with Shivon, it’s very evident she’s an amazing human and we both just want what’s best for our kids.”
Grimes told Vanity Fair in a March 2022 feature that the baby’s name is pronounced “sigh-deer-ee-el,” but nicknamed “Y.”
“There’s no real word for it,” she told the magazine when asked about her relationship status with Musk at the time. “I would probably refer to him as my boyfriend, but we’re very fluid. We live in separate houses. We’re best friends. We see each other all the time. ... We just have our own thing going on, and I don’t expect other people to understand it.”
In the interview, she also mentioned that she and Musk hoped to have more children. “We’ve always wanted at least three or four.”
On March 10, 2022, after the article was released, Grimes tweeted that she and Musk had broken up again.
Techno Mechanicus Musk (2022) — with Grimes
Techno Mechanicus Musk, nicknamed Tau, was born in mid-June 2022. His existence was not publicly disclosed until Sept. 2023, when a New York Times review of Walter Isaacson’s biography of Musk revealed that he and Grimes had welcomed another child together.
Around that same time, Grimes referenced the child in a post on X, asking for privacy and writing,“I wish I could show u how cute little Techno is but my priority rn is keeping my babies out of the public eye.” She added, “Plz respect that at this time.”
Later that month, Grimes filed a petition in California to establish parental rights, part of a custody dispute that followed the couple’s on-and-off separation.
Arcadia Musk (2024) — with Shivon Zilis
Musk and Zilis quietly welcomed a third child together in 2024. The child’s birth was not publicly announced at the time, and details about the newborn were initially limited.
After news of the birth became public, Musk dismissed suggestions that the child had been kept secret. “All our friends and family know,” he told Page Six in June 2024 “Failure to issue a press release, which would be bizarre, does not mean ‘secret.’”
On Feb. 28, 2025, Zilis celebrated Arcadia's first birthday on X.
She wrote, “Happy 1st birthday, darling Arcadia. Mommy loves you with all her heart.”
Seldon Lycurgus (2025) — with Shivon Zilis
On Arcadia’s first birthday, Zilis announced that she and Musk had welcomed another child together. Writing on X, she said they had decided to share the news publicly at that moment, introducing their son as Seldon Lycurgus.
“Discussed with Elon and, in light of beautiful Arcadia’s birthday, we felt it was better to also just share directly about our wonderful and incredible son, Seldon Lycurgus. Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much,” she said.
Romulus (2024) — with Ashley St. Clair
The child of the conservative influencer Ashley St. Clair, first identified in court filing as R.S.C., was born in Sept. 2024. In her petition, St. Clair included a photograph of Musk holding the infant, whom she identified as as their son.
In April 2025, The Wall Street Journal reported that Labcorp paternity test ordered by a New York court found a 99.9999 percent probability that Musk was the child’s father. The newspaper also reported that the boy’s name is Romulus.
Before the test results were made public, Musk said on X that he had provided St. Clair with $2.5 million and was sending her $500,000 a year, while stopping short of publicly acknowledging paternity.
“I don’t know if the child is mine or not, but am not against finding out,” he wrote. “No court order is needed.”
The dispute escalated after St. Clair made public comments expressing support for transgender people and for access to gender-affirming care for minors. In response, Musk said in interviews and on social that he planned to seek custody, arguing that he was concerned about his son’s upbringing. In a statement to CNN, he said he intended to file for custody, framing the issue as one of protecting the child’s welfare.
In Feb. 2025, St. Clair has petitioned a New York court seeking to establish Musk as the father of her baby boy and asking for sole custody.
CORRECTIONS (April 27, 2024, 4:13 p.m.): A previous version of this story misspelled Talulah Riley's first name. It has been corrected. Also, a previous version of this story stated that Musk and Grimes’ son, X Æ A-Xii, was born in May 2021, and their daughter, Exa Dark Sideræl, was born in December 2020. X was born in May 2020, and Exa was born in December 2021. Additionally, a previous version of this story stated that Grimes filed a court petition to establish parental rights in October 2023. She filed the court petition in September 2023.
Drew Weisholtz is a reporter for TODAY Digital, focusing on pop culture, nostalgia and trending stories. He has seen every episode of “Saved by the Bell” at least 50 times, longs to perfect the crane kick from “The Karate Kid” and performs stand-up comedy, while also cheering on the New York Yankees and New York Giants. A graduate of Rutgers University, he is the married father of two kids who believe he is ridiculous.

All About Elon Musk's 14 Kids and Their 4 Moms, Including Grimes
The Tesla founder most recently welcomed a son with former MAGA influencer Ashley St. Clair.
Published on April 11, 2026 @ 08:00AM
Elon Musk has welcomed 14 children with four different women: Justine Wilson, Grimes, Shivon Zilis, and Ashley St. Clair.
His firstborn son tragically passed away at just 10 weeks old in 2002.
Musk is a prominent pronatalist who has voiced concerns over falling birth rates.
Elon Musk's kids are the "love of [his] life." Beginning with the arrival of his firstborn son in 2002, the tech billionaire has (so far) welcomed 14 children: Nevada, Vivian, Griffin, Kai, Saxon, Damian, X Æ A-Xii, Exa, Strider, Azure, Techno, Arcadia, Seldon Lycurgus, and Romulus. His ex-partners and the mothers of his children include Justine Wilson, Grimes, Shivon Zilis, and Ashley St. Clair.
Musk's foray into fatherhood began with his aforementioned son Nevada, who tragically passed away at just 10 months old. He and his then-wife Justine Wilson subsequently welcomed twins Vivian and Griffin, followed by triplets Kai, Saxon, and Damian. The couple divorced in 2008. Musk later welcomed three kids with Grimes, four kids with former Tesla employee Shivon Zilis, and, most recently, a son named Romulus with Ashley St. Clair. With so many kids in the mix, eldest daughter Vivian admits she has a hard time keeping track of just how many siblings she has.
"I will say I do not actually know how many siblings I have, if you include half-siblings," the model told Teen Vogue, adding that she is on "good terms" with those she does know, despite having a strained relationship with her father.
Aside from raising his own brood, Musk is also a prominent pronatalist who has voiced concerns over falling birth rates, going so far as to claim that "If people don't have more children, civilization is going to crumble." Ahead, here's everything you should know about his 14 kids and 4 ex-partners.
Musk's firstborn son tragically passed away at just 10 weeks old from Sudden Infant Death Syndrome in 2002. His then-wife Justin Wilson later penned an essay in Marie Claire describing the incident.
"Nevada went down for a nap, placed on his back as always, and stopped breathing," she reflected in the piece, which was published in 2010. "By the time the paramedics resuscitated him, he had been deprived of oxygen for so long that he was brain-dead."
She continued, "He spent three days on life support in a hospital in Orange County before we made the decision to take him off it. I held him in my arms when he died."
Twins Vivian Jenna Wilson and Griffin
Musk's second eldest arrived after the couple underwent IVF treatment just a few months after Nevada's death. "I buried my feelings," Wilson wrote in the same Marie Claire essay. "Elon and I planned to get pregnant again as swiftly as possible. Within the next five years, I gave birth to twins, then triplets."
That twins, of course, were Vivian and Griffin. The duo was born on April 15, 2004. Vivian, who came out as transgender in 2020, legally dropped her father's surname 18 years later, adopting Wilson as her last name.
Her petition included the following explanation: "Gender Identity and the fact that I no longer live with or wish to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form," per People. Vivian has also spoken out about her relationship with her father on threads, writing, “You single-handedly disillusioned me with how gullible we are as a species because somehow people keep believing you for reasons that continue to evade me.”
Musk spoke to the Financial Times about their relationship, saying, "It's full-on communism...and a general sentiment that if you're rich, you're evil...It may change, but I have very good relationships with all the others [children]. Can't win them all."
Griffin, for his part, has largely avoided the spotlight. In May 2024, Musk confirmed on X that he had been joined by his son at an event, commenting on a photo of them together. However, Griffin is faced away from the camera.
Triplets Kai, Saxon, and Damian
Two years after giving birth to twins, Musk and Wilson announced the arrival of their triplets: Kai, Saxon, and Damian. The trio was born in 2006. Neither parent has discussed them in public, however a 2023 biography of the Tesla founder, simply titled Elon Musk, did reveal that Damian became a vegetarian at the age of 8 to "decrease [his] carbon footprint."
Following the arrival of their triplets, Musk and Wilson ended their marriage by filing for divorce in 2008.
X Æ A-Xii, originally named X Æ A-12, was born on May 4, 2020 to Musk and his then-partner Grimes. For obvious reasons, the name (and how to pronounce it) immediately confused fans of the couple.
"So, it's just X, the letter X, and then the Æ is pronounced Ash," Musk said during an appearance on The Joe Rogan Experience at the time. Grimes, however, told fans on Instagram that"It's just X, like the letter X. Then A.I. Like how you said the letter A then I." To make matters all the more confusing, Musk purchased Twitter in 2022 and renamed it X.
X Æ A-Xii has made multiple appearances alongside his dad, famously joining Musk at the White House and attending the MMA Global Possible Conference in Miami, Florida in 2023.
Like his father, X Æ A-Xii loves all things outer space. "X knows a lot about rockets. It's crazy," Grimes once told Wired. "He knows more about rockets than me." The singer added that when SpaceX's Starship rocket exploded in April 2023, the toddler was distraught. "He had, like, a three-day PTSD meltdown," she recalled. "Every hour, he was waking up and going, 'Starship ...' and I had to rub his back."
A few months after X Æ A-Xii's arrival, Musk secretly welcomed twins with former Tesla employee Shivon Zilis, People reported. Strider and Azure were born in Austin, Texas in November 2021; their birth was not publicly announced until the following summer. To complicate matters further, Grimes's second child with Musk arrived just a few weeks after Zilis gave birth.
Zilis has previously defended the father of her children on his social media platform X. “No one’s perfect but I've never met anyone who goes through more personal pain to fight for an inspiring future for humanity—and has done so tirelessly for decades,” Zilis wrote she wrote in May 2020. “Everyone’s entitled to their opinion but mine is that there’s no one I respect and admire more.”
In April 2022, the couple filed a petition to change the children's names so that they would "have their father's last name and contain their mother's last name as part of their middle name," according to People. Their names were later revealed in September 2023, an an excerpt of Walter Isaacson's biography of Musk published in Time.
In January 2026, Musk interacted with a photo of himself with the young twins on X, providing some insight into their names: "Me with my son, Strider Sekhar (named after Aragorn & great Indian physicist Chandrasekhar) and daughter, Comet Azure, named after the most powerful spell in Elden Ring."
Grimes and Musk welcomed a second child via surrogate mere weeks after Strider and Azure were born. Exa Dark Sideræl was born in December 2021. Her arrival was kept secret until March 2022. During an interview with Vanity Fair at Grimes's home, Exa, who was in another room, started crying, which led to the birth announcement.
Grimes later explained the meaning behind the name in the same interview. In short: Exa is a supercomputing term; Dark references "the unknown;" Sideræl is "a more elven" spelling of sidereal, a.k.a. "the true time of the universe, star time, deep space time, not our relative earth time."
"People fear [the unknown] but truly it's the absence of photons," Grimes told the publication. "Dark matter is the beautiful mystery of our universe."
As far as nicknames go? Grimes told X followers, "She's Y now, or 'Why?' or just '?' (But the government won't recognize that). curiosity, the eternal question, .. and such." The singer has also characterized her daughter as "a little engineer," adding, "she likes industrial shipping. She's very strange."
Grimes and Musk secretly welcomed a third child, Techno Mechanicus, who also goes by Tau, in June 2022. News of their his arrival broke thanks to Walter Isaacson's Elon Musk biography, released in September 2023.
“Tau is so amazing. He came out with eyes that could just see so deeply into your soul, with so much knowledge. He looks like a little Spock. He's definitely a Vulcan,” Grimes told the author, as quoted in the book.
Following the book's release, the singer later mentioned her son briefly on X. "I wish I could show u how cute little Techno is but my priority rn is keeping my babies out of the public eye," she wrote in September 2023. "Plz respect that at this time."
The musician provided a rare update about all three of her children in a January 2026 X post, writing, "I try to never talk abt [sic] or show my kids because they deserve the right to anonymity but i just have to say their pure aura is unmatched."
She added, "One of them even inexplicably commanded a flock of crows for while. Might be biased but this seems unusual."
Zilis gave birth to her and Musk's third child, Arcadia, on February 28, 2024. Musk confirmed the baby's birth in a statement to Page Six that June, denying allegations that the baby had been born in "secret."
“As for ‘secretly fathered,’ that is also false,” he told the outlet, adding, “All our friends and family know. Failure to issue a press release, which would be bizarre, does not mean ‘secret.'” At the time, he didn't share any additional information. However, Zilis took to X to celebrate her baby's first birthday the following year.
"Happy 1st birthday, darling Arcadia," she wrote. "Mommy loves you with all her heart."
A fourth child joined the Musk-Zilis clan sometime in late 2024/early 2025. The couple did not reveal the baby's birthdate, but did confirm his arrival in February '25 via X.
"Discussed with Elon, we felt it was better to share directly about our wonderful and incredible son Seldon Lycurgus," the mom-of-four wrote. "Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much."
Musk's 14th child was born to former MAGA influencer Ashley St. Clair at some point in the fall of 2024. The author named her son Romulus and made the surprise announcement on Musk's own platform, X.
"Five months ago, I welcomed a new baby into the world," she wrote in February 2025. "Elon Musk is the father. I have not previously disclosed this to protect our child's privacy and safety, but in recent days it has become clear that tabloid media intends to do so, regardless of the harm it will cause."
She continued, "I intend to allow our child to grow in a normal and safe environment. For that reason, I ask that the media honor our child's privacy, and refrain from invasive reporting."
Following St. Clair's post, relations quickly deteriorated between her and Musk. The Tesla founder responded with his own tweet: "I don’t know if the child is mine or not, but am not against finding out. No court order is needed." He also claimed to have sent her a massive sum of money, however St. Clair retorted that the money had been withdrawn in an act of financial retaliation.
“You weren’t sending *me* money, you were sending support for your child that you thought was necessary… until you withdrew most of it to maintain control and punish me for disobedience,” she wrote. “But you’re really only punishing your son.”
St. Clair then signed off by calling Musk a "petulant man-child." The Wall Street Journal later confirmed that Musk's "probability of paternity" was 99.9999%, according to a report from Labcorp. The mom-of-two has since filed a petition for sole custody with the New York Supreme Court, claiming Musk "has met [Romulus] only three (3) times and has had no involvement in his care and upbringing." Musk, for his part, is also seeking full custody of Romulus as of January 2026, per People.

Elon Musk's 14 Children: All About the Tesla CEO's Sons and Daughters (and the 4 Women He Shares Them With)
Elon Musk has welcomed 14 children with four different women, including three with singer Grimes
Skyler Caruso is a Staff Writer at PEOPLE. She joined the brand in 2021.
Rebecca Aizin is an Associate Editor at PEOPLE. She has been working at PEOPLE since 2023. Her work has previously appeared on Elle, HGTV and Backstage.
Updated on June 6, 2025 03:05PM EDT
Elon Musk has welcomed 14 children over 20 years.
The Tesla founder first became a father in 2002 when his ex-wife, Canadian author Justine Wilson, welcomed their son Nevada Alexander, who tragically died at 10 weeks old. The two went on to have five more children: twins Vivian and Griffin and triplets Kai, Saxon and Damian.
After divorcing Wilson in 2008 following seven years of marriage, Musk married and divorced actress Talulah Riley twice, though they never had children together. In 2020, two years after Musk and singer Grimes were first linked, the two announced they welcomed their first child, X Æ A-12, together.
The former couple share two more children, a girl, Exa Dark Sideræl, and a boy, Techno Mechanicus. A few weeks prior to the arrival of their second child, the tech CEO also secretly fathered twins, Strider and Azure, with Shivon Zilis, an executive at one of his companies, Neuralink, in November 2021, according to court documents published by Insider.
The pair then welcomed daughter Arcadia in February 2024. Later that year, a source told PEOPLE that Musk and Grimes were looking for a home in Bel Air where they could live with all of his children and their mothers.
In February 2025, author Ashley St. Clair revealed that she and Musk had welcomed a child, whose name was later revealed to be Romulus. Zilis then announced that she and Musk had secretly welcomed baby No. 4, son Seldon Lycurgus, though it's unclear when.
Another update came in May, when St. Clair told The New York Times that Musk told her that he had also fathered a child with a Japanese pop star, though this claim has not been confirmed.
Here's everything to know about Elon Musk's 14 children: Nevada, Vivian, Griffin, Kai, Saxon, Damian, X Æ A-12, Exa, Strider, Azure, Techno, Arcadia, Seldon Lycurgus and Romulus.
Musk welcomed his son, Nevada Alexander, with his first wife, Justine Wilson in 2002. Sadly, at 10 weeks old, he passed away from sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS).
"Nevada went down for a nap, placed on his back as always, and stopped breathing," Wilson wrote in a 2010 essay for Marie Claire. "By the time the paramedics resuscitated him, he had been deprived of oxygen for so long that he was brain-dead."
She continued, "He spent three days on life support in a hospital in Orange County before we made the decision to take him off it. I held him in my arms when he died."
Vivian Jenna Wilson and Griffin
In her Marie Claire essay, Wilson detailed the couple's journey to expand their family further.
"I buried my feelings ... coping with Nevada's death by making my first visit to an IVF clinic less than two months later. Elon and I planned to get pregnant again as swiftly as possible. Within the next five years, I gave birth to twins, then triplets," she wrote.
In April 2022, one of Musk's twins petitioned the court to legally change her name to Vivian Jenna Wilson (the maiden name of her mother, Justine Wilson) and to recognize her gender as female. In court documents obtained by PEOPLE, Vivian explained that she no longer wished "to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form."
The petition was eventually granted in June of that same year.
While speaking to the Financial Times in October 2022, Musk said he believes Vivian doesn't want to be associated with him because of the supposed takeover of elite schools and universities by neo-Marxists.
"It's full-on communism . . . and a general sentiment that if you're rich, you're evil," said the Tesla CEO. "It [the relationship] may change, but I have very good relationships with all the others [children]. Can't win them all."
In July 2024, after Musk said he was "tricked" into allowing Vivian to undergo gender-affirming medical treatments and stated that his "son is dead," Vivian responded on Threads.
"This entire thing is completely made up and there’s a reason for this. He doesn’t know what I was like as a child because he quite simply wasn’t there, and in the little time that he was I was relentlessly harassed for my femininity and queerness," she wrote.
During an interview with NBC News, Vivian explained her decision to speak out.
"I think he was under the assumption that I wasn’t going to say anything and I would just let this go unchallenged," she said. "Which I’m not going to do, because if you’re going to lie about me, like, blatantly to an audience of millions, I’m not just gonna let that slide. ... He was there, I want to say, maybe 10% of the time. That's generous. He had half custody, and he fully was not there."
Grimes, the mother of three of Musk's children, posted on X in support of Vivian, writing, "I love and am forever endlessly proud of Vivian."
In August 2024, Vivian made several more scathing remarks about her father on Threads, calling him "pathetic" and a "serial adulterer."
Griffin has mainly stayed out of the public eye but joined his father at an American Express event in Miami in May 2024. "That’s my eldest son, Griffin, who was with me at the event," Musk wrote on X under a photo of the two.
Vivian said she doesn't consider all of Musk's children her siblings in a March 2025 interview with Teen Vogue.
"I will say I do not actually know how many siblings I have, if you include half-siblings. That's just a fun fact," she said. "It's really good for two truths and a lie. I found out about the Shivon Zilis thing the same time everyone else did."
In a March 2025 interview with YouTube influencer Hasan Piker, Vivian said that her transition isn't "some tragic character motivation" that led to her dad's political leanings.
“[Elon Musk] was not a liberal darling. I f------ know him, he was never on the left. It was a marketing scheme," she said.
Wilson gave birth to triplet boys named Kai, Saxon and Damian in 2006, two years after having twins. She revealed in a 2017 TedTalk that they were also conceived via IVF, but she and Musk have not discussed the children themselves publicly.
In a 2023 biography on the tech mogul, titled Elon Musk, author Walter Isaacson wrote about Damian, who he said became a vegetarian at age 8 to "decrease my carbon footprint."
Isaacson also mentioned that Damian is a classical music prodigy who excelled in math and physics. Musk's mom, Maye, even once told her son, "I think Damian is brighter than you."
Grimes and Musk welcomed their first child on May 4, 2020, after the singer announced her pregnancy with a picture of her baby bump back in January 2020. Their son, X Æ A-12, whose name was later changed to X Æ A-Xii, was in part named after the CIA's Lockheed A-12 reconnaissance plane.
Though nicknamed "X," Grimes broke down his pronunciation in her Instagram comment section. "It's just X, like the letter X," she wrote. "Then A.I.," she added. "Like how you said the letter A then I."
But Musk explained the pronunciation differently, saying on The Joe Rogan Experience podcast that "X" is spoken "like the letter" while "the 'Æ' is pronounced like 'ash.' "
While proudly stating that "A-12 was [his] contribution," he said it was Grimes who "mostly came up with the name." She even gave a thorough description of the meaning behind it on her X.
The boy later made headlines when he joined his dad for a tense meeting at X at the age of 2.
According to The Washington Post, Musk brought X Æ A-Xii to X's offices while meeting with Trust and Safety Office Yoel Roth in October 2022. The child was reportedly running around the building as Musk discussed the company's future. X Æ A-Xii also made himself comfortable in the conference room, which the newspaper reported "was strewn with toys."
In April 2023, X Æ A-Xii tagged along with his dad to the MMA Global Possible Conference in Miami. The little boy was seen playing with Musk on stage, which the audience found heartwarming.
Four months later, Grimes opened up about her son's love of spacecraft. "X knows a lot about rockets. It's crazy," she explained. "He knows more about rockets than me."
She even admitted that she was worried about his "obsession with space" after SpaceX's Starship rocket exploded after takeoff in April.
"When X saw Starship blow up, he had, like, a three-day PTSD meltdown," the mom of two said. "Every hour, he was waking up and going, 'Starship ...' and I had to rub his back."
In February 2025, X Æ A-Xii accompanied his dad on a visit to the Oval Office to witness President Donald Trump sign an executive order that gave the Department of Government Efficiency more power.
Grimes reacted to the news on X, writing that she wasn't aware her son was there and that she had only found out from a user on the platform.
"He should not be in public like this," the singer wrote. "I did not see this, thank u for alerting me. But I'm glad he was polite. Sigh."
After Musk showed up for a press conference in the Oval Office with a black eye in May 2025, he told a reporter he'd gotten the injury while roughhousing with X Æ A-Xii.
"I was walking around with Little X and I said, 'Go ahead and punch me in the face,' and he did," he said. "I didn't really feel much at the time but I guess it bruises up."
Musk secretly welcomed twins, son Strider and daughter Azure, with Shivon Zilis in November 2021, according to court documents published by Insider. The twins were born in Austin, Texas — just weeks before he and Grimes welcomed a baby girl via a surrogate.
The papers reveal that in April 2022, Musk and Zilis asked a Texan county court to change their babies' names so they would "have their father's last name and contain their mother's last name as part of their middle name."
The parents revealed the babies' names and sexes in September 2023, when they were 16 months old.
Grimes revealed a year later in a Vanity Fair interview that she welcomed a baby girl via surrogate in December 2021, three months after the couple's public breakup. Named Exa Dark Sideræl, the singer-songwriter explained that her name has a double meaning.
Exa refers to a supercomputing term, exaFLOPS, while Dark represents "the unknown." She explained to the outlet, "People fear it but truly it's the absence of photons. Dark matter is the beautiful mystery of our universe."
The third part of Y's full name, Sideræl, is pronounced "sigh-deer-ee-el," according to Vanity Fair. Grimes described the word as "a more elven" spelling of sidereal, which she defined as "the true time of the universe, star time, deep space time, not our relative earth time."
The second meaning of Sideræl is a nod to Grimes' favorite Lord of the Rings character, Galadriel, who "chooses to abdicate the ring."
In March 2023, Grimes shared a rare photo of her daughter on Twitter — and revealed that the little girl is going by a new name.
"Normally we [don't] post her for her privacy, but she's fairly unrecognizable here since shes channeling Goku," she wrote in the comments, referring to a Dragon Ball character. The photo showed Musk's youngest in a red onesie with super blonde spiked hair.
In a separate comment, Grimes said: "She's Y now, or "Why?" or just "?" (But the government won't recognize that). curiosity, the eternal question, .. and such."
In August 2023, Grimes described her younger child as "a little engineer," and said, "she likes industrial shipping. She's very strange."
Isaacson's biography about Musk revealed the birth of the Tesla founder's third child with Grimes. The couple secretly welcomed a second son, Techno Mechanicus, who also goes by “Tau," in June 2022.
“Tau is so amazing. He came out with eyes that could just see so deeply into your soul, with so much knowledge. He looks like a little Spock. He's definitely a Vulcan,” Grimes told Isaacson in the biography.
Following the book's release, Grimes wrote on X that she was keeping further details about her youngest child private.
"I wish I could show u how cute little Techno is but my priority rn is keeping my babies out of the public eye," she wrote. "Plz respect that at this time."
In June 2024, Musk confirmed the arrival of his third child with Zilis. Their daughter, Arcadia, was born on Feb. 28, 2024.
"Mommy loves you with all her heart," Zilis wrote on X in honor of Arcadia's first birthday in February 2025.
Zilis announced on X in February 2025 that she and Musk had welcomed their fourth child, son Seldon Lycurgus. However, she did not reveal her baby boy's birthdate.
"Discussed with Elon, we felt it was better to share directly about our wonderful and incredible son Seldon Lycurgus. Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much," the mom of four wrote.
In February 2025, St. Clair posted an announcement to X, revealing that she and Musk welcomed a child together in September 2024.
"Five months ago, I welcomed a new baby into the world. Elon Musk is the father. I have not previously disclosed this to protect our child's privacy and safety, but in recent days it has become clear that tabloid media intends to do so, regardless of the harm it will cause," she wrote.
"I intend to allow our child to grow in a normal and safe environment," St. Clair continued. "For that reason, I ask that the media honor our child's privacy, and refrain from invasive reporting."
It's unclear if St. Clair's child was born before or after Musk and Zilis welcomed baby No. 4.

results.title: Elon Musk's kids: Meet his 14 children and their mothers
results.content:
See more of our coverage in your search results.
Elon Musk’s brood just keeps growing.
The Tesla mogul has at least 14 children with four women.
Musk welcomed six kids with his first wife, Justine Wilson, three with his ex-girlfriend Grimes, four with his Neuralink executive Shivon Zilis and reportedly another one with author Ashley St. Clair.
Musk addressed his big brood in July 2022 by tweeting, “Doing my best to help the underpopulation crisis. A collapsing birth rate is the biggest danger civilization faces by far.”
The following month, he called low birth rates a “much bigger risk to civilization than global warming.”
Meet the billionaire businessman’s kids and their mothers below.
After marrying in January 2000, Musk and Canadian author Wilson welcomed son Nevada Alexander Musk in 2002.
Nevada died of sudden infant death syndrome, or SIDS, at only 10 weeks.
After losing their firstborn, Musk and Wilson turned to IVF to grow their family. She gave birth to twins Griffin and Vivian Musk in April 2004.
Vivian came out as transgender in June 2022 when she filed a request to change her first name and take the last name of her mom.
The filing listed the reason as “gender identity and the fact that I no longer live with or wish to be related to my biological father in any way, shape or form.”
Two years later, Musk claimed he had been “essentially tricked into signing documents” allowing Vivian’s gender reassignment before sensationally using his daughter’s deadname to say she was “dead — killed by the woke-mind virus.”
Not only did Vivian clap back — and have Grimes come to her defense — but she labeled her estranged dad a “serial adulterer who won’t stop f–king lying about [his] own children” in August 2024.
Seven months later, Vivian called Musk a “pathetic man-child” and alleged that his once-leftist stance was nothing but a “marketing scheme.”
Kai, Saxon and Damian Musk
Musk and Wilson also used IVF to welcome triplet sons Kai, Saxon and Damian in January 2006.
The trio remains primarily out of the spotlight.
The former couple divorced in 2008.
After two marriages to “Westworld” star Talulah Riley and a brief relationship with actress Amber Heard, Musk started dating singer Grimes, whose real name is Claire Elise Boucher, in 2018. She gave birth to their son, X AE A-XII, in May 2020.
X was originally named X Æ A-12, but “Æ” and “12” violated California law for not being part of the English alphabet, forcing his parents to change his name.
Page Six exclusively reported in September 2021 that Musk and Grimes had broken up.
The duo have since been engaged in a contentious custody battle, with the singer claiming in November 2024 that Musk had kept her from seeing one of their children for five months.
Grimes revealed to Vanity Fair in March 2022 that she and the SpaceX founder welcomed their first daughter, the unusually named Exa Dark Sideræl Musk, via surrogate in December 2021. Exa was given the nickname Y.
Grimes referred to Musk as her “boyfriend” in the bombshell interview, though she called their relationship “fluid.” Hours after the cover story was published, however, she tweeted that they had since split again.
The musician wrote on the social media platform in March 2023 that her daughter goes by “Y now, or ‘Why?’ or just ‘?’” However, she admitted the “government won’t recognize” the symbol.
Musk quietly welcomed twins with Neuralink director of operations and special projects Zilis in November 2021, according to court documents obtained by Business Insider in July 2022.
The X CEO and Zilis reportedly filed a petition to change the twins’s names in order to “have their father’s last name and contain their mother’s last name as part of their middle name,” which a judge in Austin, Texas, approved in May 2022.
The children’s names — Strider and Azure — were revealed in September 2023.
The tech giant quietly welcomed a third child with Grimes, named Techno Mechanicus, according to Walter Isaacson’s biography “Elon Musk,” published in September 2023.
Very little is known about the little one, who is believed to have arrived around June 2022.
The exes have nicknamed the child “Tau.”
Bloomberg reported in June 2024 that Musk and Zilis had a third child together at the start of the year.
Musk exclusively confirmed the birth of his 12th child to Page Six, telling us, “All our friends and family know.”
The name and sex of the tot were not immediately known, but in February 2025, Zilis announced on X the baby’s name is Arcadia.
In February 2025, author Ashley St. Clair claimed in a statement shared on X that she and Musk had welcomed a child together in September 2024.
“Five months ago, I welcomed a new baby into the world. Elon Musk is the father. I have not previously disclosed this to protect our child’s privacy and safety, but in recent days it has become clear that tabloid media intends to do so, regardless of the harm it will cause,” she wrote.
The “Elephants Are Not Birds” author later urged Musk in another X post to communicate with her so they could reach an agreement on how to raise their alleged child together.
“Elon, we have been trying to communicate for the past several days and you have not responded,” she wrote in a now-deleted tweet. “When are you going to reply to us instead of publicly responding to smears from an individual who just posted photos of me in underwear at 15 years old?”
A representative for St. Clair then shared a statement on X, stating that she and the SpaceX founder had been “privately working towards the creation of an agreement about raising their child for some time.”
St. Clair eventually sued Musk for sole custody of their child, a decision she claims led the billionaire to “substantially” reduce child-support payments — and question the paternity of the tot.
To get back at Musk, St. Clair savagely sold her Tesla.
In April 2025, St. Clair revealed her baby’s unusual name, Romulus, to the Wall Street Journal.
The article broke down the little one’s alleged conception in St. Barts, with St. Clair also detailing the $15 million agreement she refused to sign keeping Musk’s paternity under wraps.
The outlet, additionally, shared the results from Musk’s Labcorp paternity test, highlighting the “99.9999 percent” certainty he is Romulus’ father.
In February 2025, the same day Zilis announced the name of the couple’s third child, she revealed she gave birth to a baby boy named Seldon Lycurgus.
“Discussed with Elon and, in light of beautiful Arcadia’s birthday, we felt it was better to also just share directly about our wonderful and incredible son Seldon Lycurgus,” she wrote on X. “Built like a juggernaut, with a solid heart of gold. Love him so much ♥️”
Musk seemingly confirmed the news of their fourth child, replying with a heart emoji.
It’s unknown when the pair welcomed Seldon.
